next.reason: Class/category numeric with an operational sign (§2023:15.2 GR4) and the ban on a numeric function where an integer operand is required (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR11) carry over; implementor-defined characteristics survive only for native arithmetic (§2023:15.4.1, §2023:A.1 92). But 1989 'A numeric function may be used only in an arithmetic expression'; 2023 drops that limit: a function 'may be used anywhere a sending data item of that class and category may be specified' (§2023:15.2 lead text, no catalog row). Looser.
